instruction: Can you enable autosave for volume levels? I want VLC to remember my volume settings between sessions.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
